about: Canonical system health (src/system_health.build_artifact), written daily by evidence_refresh.yml. overall: FAIL if any RED check or protected_tracks_modified; WARN if any AMBER/NO_DATA; PASS otherwise. Every status comes from the rule stored beside it. `indicators` holds FOUR separate verdicts (CI gate, operational data quality, production model integrity, full-system certification) - never one GREEN for all four.
